descriptionHtml:
Lenovo LOQ essential 15IAX9E Gaming Laptop - Intel Core i5-12450HX - RTX 3050 6GB - Black Edition

Gear up for elite gaming and seamless multitasking with the Lenovo LOQ essential 15IAX9E. Powered by the high-performance Intel Core i5-12450HX processor and backed by the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 6GB graphics card, this gaming laptop delivers smooth frame rates and vibrant visuals for modern esports titles. Available at Turbo Computer, it features a stunning 15.6-inch FHD IPS display with a 144Hz refresh rate and 100% sRGB color gamut for precise color accuracy and fluid motion. Designed with a sleek Luna Grey chassis and a white backlit keyboard, this laptop comes packaged with a Lenovo LOQ M100 RGB gaming mouse as a special bundle, backed by a 1-year warranty.
